objective: Replace impossible axis-aligned OOO cubes with an outcome-independent dual certificate basis: freeze the left-kernel dependencies of the complete degree<=2 repaired P/O feature matrix, map those dependencies into the complete OOO structural residue space, and only after that structural quotient is frozen annotate each dependency with its two-bit scalar XOR.

frozenMatrices.rows: Distinct scalar-pure repaired structural classes, ordered lexicographically by complete repaired signature; duplicate physical states are collapsed before algebra.
frozenMatrices.lower: Complete constant/affine P/O columns plus every observed square-free degree-2 P/O column.
frozenMatrices.cubic: Every observed O_a O_b O_c column for three distinct repaired descriptor identities.
frozenMatrices.outcomes: Relative W/D/L code L=00,D=01,W=10; excluded from all basis selection.

structuralProcedure: Run deterministic sparse GF(2) row elimination on the frozen degree<=2 matrix only.
Every row that structurally reduces to zero freezes one matched dependency in a deterministic left-kernel basis; outcome labels are not consulted.
Carry the complete OOO feature row through exactly the same structural elimination to obtain the dependency's OOO residue.
Reduce the frozen dependency residues among themselves, again without outcomes, to obtain a basis for the image of ker(D2^T) under the OOO map.
Only after both bases are frozen, replay the same reductions with the two-bit scalar column and record each dependency's scalar XOR.
measurements: OOO-residue zero/nonzero histogram and residue-weight histogram
dimension of scalar dependency image in GF(2)^2
scalar-code histogram on the structurally frozen dependency basis
dimension of scalar image restricted to the structurally independent OOO-residue basis
whether every dependency with zero OOO residue has zero scalar residue
whether OOO-residue rank reproduces the independently measured OOO rank gain over degree 2
antiCircularity: All class ordering, degree<=2 elimination pivots, dependency selection, OOO residue construction, and OOO residue-basis selection are functions only of frozen structural rows.
Scalar W/D/L codes are attached only after the structural dependency and residue bases are frozen.
No dependency is selected because its scalar XOR is nonzero.
Individual dependency-basis elements remain gauge/order representatives; the left-nullity, OOO image rank, scalar image dimension, and factorization statements are the invariants.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: OOO-residue image rank differs from the independently measured OOO rank gain over complete degree 2.
Any structurally zero OOO residue carries a nonzero scalar residue despite OOO-only cubic exactness.
Scalar dependency image has dimension larger than the previously measured target quotient on the same carrier.
Any outcome access influences a pivot, dependency, or structural residue selection.
nextIfControlsHold: Use the frozen matched-dependency/OOO-residue quotient as the invariant discovery carrier for mechanically generated descriptor-motif functionals and DTS exchange/circuit annotations; do not fit or unseal the formula holdout until a closed structural syndrome family is frozen.
interpretationGuards: A deterministic matched dependency is a basis representative, not automatically a minimal matroid circuit.
Nonzero scalar XOR on a dependency is a direct certificate that degree<=2 cannot realize the scalar target on that relation.
This experiment tests Q-V decoder structure only and does not establish Q-A, Q-F, universal cubic sufficiency, 7x6 sufficiency, or a center-opening proof.
